English: The GRCh37 human genome assembly is still widely used in genomics despite the fact an updated human genome assembly (GRCh38) has been available for many years.

Zulu: Inhlanganisa yama-genomes abantu i-GRCh37 isasetshenziswa kwi-genomics ngale kokuthi kukhona inhlanganisa yama-genomes ebuyekeziwe (GRCh38) isineminyaka ikhona.
Hausa: Har yanzu ana amfani da tsarin genom na ɗan’adam na GRCh37 a cikin ilimin hallita duk da cewa an sami sabunta tsarin halittar ɗan’adam (GRCh38) tsawon shekaru da yawa.
Northern Sotho: Tatelanyo ya tlhamegotšini tša batho ya GRCh37 e dutše e sa šomišwa ka bophara go ditšenomiki le ge e le gore tatelanyo ya tlhamegotšini tša batho ye e nago le tshedimošo ya bjale (GRCh38) ke mengwaya ye mentši e hwetšagala.

English: A particular issue with relevant ramifications for clinical genetics currently is the case of the GRCh37 Ensembl gene annotations which has been archived, and thus not updated, since 2013.

Yoruba: Ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ pàtàkì kan pẹ̀lú àbájáde tí ó wúlo fún ẹ̀jẹ̀-ìbí ajẹmọ́tọ̀ọ́jú lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ ni ọ̀rọ̀ àlàyé ibùdó ẹ̀jẹ̀-ìbí GRCh37 tí wọ́n ti fi pamọ́, tí wọn kò sì sọ dọ̀tun, láti ọdún 2013.
Zulu: Inkinga ekhona ngemiphumela yezakhi zofuzo kwezokwelapha indaba ye-GRCh37 Ensembl gene annotations esezinqolobaneni, okusho ukuthi ayibuyekeziwe kusukela ngo-2013.
Hausa: Wani batu na musamman da ke da tasiri ga qwayoyin halitta na asibiti a halin yanzu shi ne batun GRCh37 Ensembl gene wanda aka adana, kuma don haka ba a sabunta ba, tun daga 2013.
Northern Sotho: Ntlha ye e itšego ye e nago le ditlamorago tša maleba go ditlhamegotšini tša diteko tša kalafo gabjale ke bothata bja ditlhalošo tša ditšini tša Ensembl tša GRCh37 tšeo di lotilwego, gomme di sego tša mpshafatšwa tshedimošo, go tloga ka 2013.

English: These Ensembl GRCh37 gene annotations are just as ubiquitous as the former assembly and are the default gene models used and preferred by the majority of genomic projects internationally.
Luganda: Emminjawaza z’endagabutonde zino eza Ensembl GRCh37 ziri buli wamu ng’omuteeko ogwaliko era nga gy’emitetenkanyizo gy’endagabutonde egisooka okulowoozebwako okukozesebwa era egyagalwa mu pulojekiti z’okunoonyereza ku ndagabutonde okwetooloola ensi.
Yoruba: Àwọn ibùdó ẹ̀jẹ̀-ìbí GRCh37 kàn wọ́pọ̀ káàkiri bí i àgbájọ àtẹ̀yìnwá, wọ́n sì jẹ́ apata ẹ̀yà-ìbí ìpìlẹ̀ tí ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwádìí ajẹmẹ́jẹ̀-ìbí káàkiri àgbááyé lò, tí wọ́n sì nífẹ̀ẹ́ sí.

Amharic: እነዚህ ኤንሴምብል GRCh37 የጂን ማብራሪያዎች ልክ እንደቀድሞው ስብስብ በሁሉም ቦታ የሚገኙ እና በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ተመራጭ እና በአብዛኛው የጂኖሚክ ፕሮጀክቶች ጥቅም ላይ የሚውሉ ነባር የጂን ሞዴሎች ናቸው፡፡

English: In this study, we highlight the issue of genes with discrepant annotations, that have been recognized as protein coding in the new but not the old assembly.

Yoruba: Nínú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, a ṣàgbéjáde ọ̀rọ̀ àwọn ẹ̀jẹ̀-ìbí tí wọ́n ní alálàyé tó ń takora, tí wọ́n rí gẹ́gẹ́ bí lílajú èròjà amáradàgbà nínú tuntun, ṣùgbọ́n tí kò rí bẹ́ẹ̀ nínú àwọn àgbájọ ti àtijọ́.

Northern Sotho: Ka dinyakišišong tše, re gatelela ntlha ya ditšini ka ditlhalošo tše di thulanago, tšeo di lemogilwego bjalo ka go khouta ga protheine ka go tatelanyo ye mpsha eupša e sego ya kgale.

Northern Sotho: Ditšini tše di hlokomologilwe ke methopo ka moka ya tšenomiki yeo e dutšego e tshephile dilthalošo tša ditšini tše di lotilwego le tšeo e lego tša kgale.

Yoruba: Ìṣòro rẹ̀ ni pé ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn irin-iṣẹ́ aláìrídìmú tí àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ǹsì lò ní ó kàn yẹ àwọn ẹ̀jẹ̀-ìbí kan tí a mọ̀ pé wọ́n ṣe pàtàkì sílẹ̀, nítorí àlàyé tí kò bágbà mu.
Zulu: Inkinga ukuthi ama-software amaningi asetshenziwa ilabososayensi ayilunaki ufuzo esilwazi lubalulekile, ngenxa yolwazi oluphelelwe isikhathi.
Hausa: Matsalar ita ce yawancin kayan aikin na’ura da waɗannan masana kimiyya ke amfani da su kawai suna yin watsi da qwayoyin halitta waɗanda a yanzu muka san suna da mahimmanci, saboda tsofaffin bayanai.
Northern Sotho: Bothata ke gore bontši bja didirišwa tša softewere tšeo ditsebi tše tša mahlale di di šomišago di hlokomologa ka boomo ditšini tšeo gabjale re tsebago gore di bohlokwa, ka lebaka la tshedimošo ye e fetilwego ke nako.
Amharic: ችግሩ ሳይንቲስቶቹ የሚጠቀሙባቸው ብዙዎቹ የሶፍትዌር መሳሪያዎች ጊዜው ባለፈበት መረጃ ምክንያት አሁን ላይ አስፈላጊ እንደሆኑ የምናውቃቸውን ጂኖች በቀላሉ ችላ ማለታቸው ነው፡፡

English: As a result, scientists may not have all the relevant information, when running their genetic studies.
Luganda: Olw’ensonga eyo, bannassaayansi bayinza obutaba na bubaka bwonna obw’omugaso nga bakola okunoonyereza kwabwe ku ndagabutonde.
Yoruba: Fún ìdí èyí, àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ǹń̀sì lè má nìí gbogbo àwọn àlàyé tí ó wúlò, nígbà tí wọ́n bá ń gùnlé àgbéyèwò ajẹmọ́-ẹ̀jẹ̀-ìbí wọn.
Zulu: Umphumela, kungaba ukuthi ososayensi bangangaba nayo imininingwane efanele, uma benza ucwaningo ngofuzo.
Hausa: A sakamakon haka, masana kimiyya ba za su sami duk bayanan da suka dace ba, lokacin da suke gudanar da nazarin qwayoyin halitta.
Northern Sotho: Ka gona, ditsebi tša mahlale di ka no se be le tshedimošo ye bohlokwa ka moka, ge di dira dinyakišišo tša tšona tša tlhamegotšini.
Amharic: በዚህም ምክንያት የጄኔቲካዊ ጥናቶቻቸውን በሚያካሂዱበት ጊዜ ሳይንቲስቶች አሰፈላጊው ሁሉ መረጃ ላይኖራቸው ይችላል፡፡

English: The researchers in this study wanted to understand how much information was being lost when scientists used the older assembly, which dates to 2013.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baali baagala okutegeera omuwendo gw’obubaka obwali bufiibwa bannassaayansi bwe baakozesa omuteeko omukadde ogwafuluma mu 2013.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí nínú ìwádìí èyí fẹ́ ní òye iye àwọn àlàyé tí ó jẹ́ pípàdánù nígbà tí àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ǹsì ṣàmúlò àgbájọ àtijọ́ náà, léyìí tí ó lọ títí dé ọdún 2013.
Zulu: Abacwaningi kulolucwaningo bebefuna ukuqonda ukuthi lungakanani ulwazi obelulahleka uma ososayensi besebenzisa inhlanganisa endala, okwatholakala ngo-2013.
Hausa: Masu bincike a cikin wannan binciken sun so su fahimci yawan bayanan da aka rasa lokacin da masana kimiyya suka yi amfani da tsohon tsarin, wanda ya kasance a cikin shekarar 2013.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ka dinyakišišong tše ba be ba nyaka go kwešiša gore ke tshedimošo ye kae yeo e bego e lahlega ge ditsebi tša mahlale di be di šomiša tatelanyo ya kgale, yeo e fihlago go ngwaga wa 2013.
Amharic: የዚህ ጥናት ተመራማሪዎች ሳይንቲስቶች እ.ኢ.አ እስከ 2013ዓ.ም ድረስ ያሉ የድሮ ስብስብን በሚጠቀሙበት ጊዜ ምን ያህል መረጃ እየጠፋ እንዳላ ለመረዳት ወጥነው ነበር፡፡ በተለይም በአዲሱ ስብስብ ውስጥ ምን ያህል የጂን መረጃ እንደተሻሻለ እና እነዚህም ጂኖች ምን ሚና እንደሚጫወቱ የማወቅ ፍላጎት ነበራችው፡፡

English: In particular, they were interested in how much genetic information has been updated in the new assembly, and what those genes do.
Luganda: Okutwaliza awamu, baali baagala omuwendo gw’obubaka obukwata ku ndagabutonde obwongeddwa mu muteeko omupya n’omugaso gw’endagabutonde ezo.
Yoruba: Ní pàtàkì, wọ́n ní ìfẹ́ sí iye àwọn àlàyé nípa ẹ̀jẹ̀-ìbí tí a ti sọ dọ̀tun nínú àgbájọ tuntun, àti iṣẹ́ tí àwọn ẹ̀jẹ̀-ìbí náà ń ṣe.
Zulu: Into abebeyinake kakhulu ukuthi ulwazi lofuzo olungakanani olubuyekeziwe enhlanganiseni entsha, nokuthi lolo fuzo lwenzani.
Hausa: Musamman, suna sha'awar yadda aka sabunta bayanan qwayoyin halitta a cikin sabon tsarin, da abin da waɗannan qwayoyin suke yi..
Northern Sotho: Gabotsebotse, ba be ba na le kgahlego ya gore ke tshedimošo ye kaakang ya tlhamegotšini yeo e mpshafaditšwego go tatelanyo ye mpsha, le tšeo di dirwago ke ditšini tšeo.
Amharic: በተለይም በአዲሱ ስብስብ ውስጥ ምን ያህል የጂን መረጃ እንደተሻሻለ እና እነዚህም ጂኖች ምን ሚና እንደሚጫወቱ የማወቅ ፍላጎት ነበራችው፡፡

English: To find out, they analysed and compared the two gene assemblies, looking for cases where new information had been added about the function of certain genes.
Luganda: Okusobola okuzuula, beekaliriza era ne bageraageranya emiteeko gy’endagabutonde ebiri nga banoonya ewantu ewaali wongeddwa obubaka obupya ku mugaso gw’endagabutonde ezimu.
Yoruba: Láti ṣèwádìí, wọ́n ṣe àtúpalẹ̀, wọ́n sì ṣe àfiwéra àwọn àgbájọ ojúlé ẹ̀jẹ̀-ìbí méjì, tí wọn ń wá àwọn ibi tí a ti ṣe àfikún àlàyé tuntun nípa ojúṣe àwọn ẹ̀jẹ̀-ìbí kọ̀ọ̀kan.
Zulu: Ukuthola lokho, bahlaziye baqathanisa izinhlanganisa zofuzo ezimbili, bebheka izimo lapho kufakwe khona ulwazi olusha olwengeziwe ngokusebenza kofuzo oluthize.
Hausa: Don su gane, sun bincika kuma sun kwatanta tarukan ƙwayoyin halitta guda biyu, suna neman lokuta da aka ƙara sababbin bayanai game da aikin wasu qwayoyin halitta.
Northern Sotho: Go hwetša dikarabo, ba sekasekile le go bapetša ditatelanyo tša ditšini tše pedi, ba nyakana le moo go tsentšwego tshedimošo ye mpsha mabapi le mošomo wa ditšini tše dingwe.
Amharic: ይህን ለማወቅ ሁለቱን የጂን ስብስቦች ያወዳደሩ እና የተነተኑ ሲሆን ስለ ጂኖች ተግባር አዲስ መረጃ የተጨመሩባቸውን ክስተቶች አስሰዋል፡፡

English: They then looked at medical and genetic databases to find any links between those genes and diseases.
Luganda: Oluvannyuma baatunuulira obubaka obuli mu malwaliro n’obwo obukwata ku ndagabutonde okusobola okuzuula enkolagana wakati w’endagabutonde ezo n’endwadde.
Yoruba: Wọ́n wá wo kóló-àkọsílẹ̀ ètò-ìlera àti ti ẹ̀jẹ̀-ìbí láti wá àsopọ̀ yìówù kí ó wà láàrin ẹ̀jẹ̀-ìbí àti ààrùn.
Zulu: Babe sebebheka ama-database ezokwelapha nawofuzo ukuze bathole ukuhlangana phakathi kofuzi nezifo.
Hausa: Daga nan sai suka duba kundayen bayanan likitanci da qwayoyin halitta don gano wata alaqa tsakanin wadannan qwayoyin halitta da cututtuka.
Northern Sotho: Ke moka ba lebelela didathapeisi tša malwetši le tša tlhamegotšini go utolla dikamano dife goba dife magareng ga ditšini le malwetši ao.
Amharic: ከዛ በእነዛ ጂኖች እና በበሽታ መሃል ግንኙነት እንዳለ ለማወቅ የህክምና እና የጄኔቲክ የመረጃ ቋትን አይተዋል፡፡

English: The researchers found hundreds of genes that had been recategorised in the new database.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baazuula ebikumi by’endagabutonde ebyali bibinjawaziddwa nate mu muteeko omupya.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣàwárí ọgọgọ́rùn-ún àwọn ẹ̀jẹ̀-ìbí tí a ti ṣe àtúnpín wọn lábẹ́ kóló-àkọsílẹ̀ tuntun.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathole amakhulu ofuzo obeselubhalwe kabusha kwi-database entsha.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gano xaruruwan qwayoyin halitta da aka sake rarraba su a cikin sabon bayanan.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba hweditše makgolokgolo a ditšini tšeo di hlophilwego leswa go dathapeisi ye mpsha.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በአዲሱ የመረጃ ቋት እንደአዲስ የተከፋፈሉ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ጂኖችን አግኝተዋል፡፡

English: Many of these are involved in making proteins in the body.
Luganda: Nnyingi ku zino zeenyigira mu kukola puloteyini mu mubiri.
Yoruba: Ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ wọn ni wọ́n nííṣe pẹ̀lú ṣíṣẹ̀dá èròjà amáradàgbà nínú ara.
Zulu: Iningi lalo zibandakanyeka ekwakheni amaphrotheni emzimbeni.
Hausa: Yawancin waɗannan suna da hannu wajen samar da furotin a jiki.
Northern Sotho: Bontši bja tšona di a amega go tlhamo ya diprotheine mmeleng.
Amharic: ከእነዚህ አብዛኛዎቹ በሰውነት ውስጥ ፕሮቲኖችን በመስራት ላይ ይሳተፋሉ፡፡

English: The names used to identify some of these genes have also changed, making it even more difficult for scientists to match up information when working with the older database.
Luganda: Amannya agaakozesebwa okutegeeza ezimu ku ndagabutonde zino nago gakyuse, ne kyongera okufuuka ekizibu eri bannassaayansi okukwanaganya obubaka nga bakozesa omuteeko omukadde.
Yoruba: Àwọn orúkọ tí a fi ń dá àwọn ẹ̀jẹ̀-ìbí kọ̀ọ̀kan mọ̀ ti yípadà pẹ̀lú, léyìí tí ó mú kí ó nira síi fún àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ǹsì láti to àwọn àlàyé pọ̀ nígbà tí wọ́n bá ń ṣiṣẹ́ lórí àwọn kóló-àkọsílẹ̀ àtijọ́.
Zulu: Amagama asetshenziswa ukukhomba olunye lwalolu fuzo aseshintshile, okwenza kubenzima ukuthi ososayensi baqondanise ulwazi uma besebenza nge-database endala.
Hausa: Sunaye da ake amfani da su don gano wasu daga cikin waɗannan qwayoyin halitta su ma sun canza, wanda hakan ya sa ya zama da wahala masana kimiyya su daidaita bayanai yayin aiki tare da tsofaffin bayanai.
Northern Sotho: Maina ao a šomišitšwego go hlaola tše dingwe tša ditšini tše le ona a fetogile, a dira gore go be boima kudu gore ditsebi tša mahlale di bapetše tshedimošo ge di šoma ka dathapeisi ya kgale.
Amharic: እነዚህን ጂኖች ለይቶ ለማውጣት ጥቅም ላይ የዋሉት ስሞችም ተቀይረዋል፤ ይህ ደግሞ በድሮው የመረጃ ቋት ላይ በሚሰሩበት ጊዜ ሳይንቲስቶች መረጃዎችን ለማመሳሰል የበለጠ አስቸግሯቸዋል፡፡

English: A few of these genes were also associated with specific diseases, for example the KIZ gene, which is linked to retinitis pigmentosa – a disease that can cause loss of sight.
Luganda: Ezimu ku ndagabutonde zino era zaali zeekuusa ku ndwadde ezimu, okugeza, endagabutonde ya KIZ eyeekuusa ku kifu ky’oku maaso – obulwadde obusobola obuviirako omuntu okuba nga talaba.
Yoruba: Díẹ̀ lára àwọn ẹ̀jẹ̀-ìbí náà ni wọ́n ní àsopọ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn irúfẹ́ ààrùn kan, fún àpẹẹrẹ ẹ̀jẹ̀-ìbí KIZ, tí ó ní àsopọ̀ pẹ̀lú rétíníìsì pimẹntósà – ààrùn kan tí ó lè fọ́ni lójú.
Zulu: Okunye ufuzo olumbalwa lubandakanywa nezifo ezithize, isibonelo ufuzo i-KIZ, uluhlangene ne- retinitis pigmentosa – isifo esingadala ukulahlekelwa ukubona.
Hausa: Kaxan daga cikin wadannan qwayoyin halittar kuma an haxe su da wasu cututtuka na musamman, misali qwayar halittar KIZ, wacce ke da alaqa da retinitis pigmentosa  – cuta da ke haifar da asarar gani.
Northern Sotho: Palo ye nnyane ya ditšini tše le yona e ile ya amantšhwa le malwetši ao a itšego, mohlala, tšini ya KIZ, ye e amantšhwago le retinitis pigmentosa – e lego bolwetši bjoo bo ka hlolago go foufala.
Amharic: ከእነዚህ የተወሰኑት ጂኖች ከተወሰኑ በሽታዎች ጋር የተቆራኙ ሲሆን ለምሳሌ KIZ የሚባለው ጂን ከሬቲኒቲስ ፒግሜንቶሳ ጋር የተያያዘ ነው - የአይን መጥፋትን ሊያስከትል የሚችል በሽታ፡፡

English: The study shows that it’s vital for researchers to use up-to-date genetic information to make sure diseases are linked to the genes that cause them, particularly where this information is being used in medical diagnoses.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kulaga nti abanoonyereza basaanye bakozese obubaka bw’endagabutonde obuliko okukakasa nti obulwadde bukwasaganyizibwa n’endagabutonde ezibuleeta, n’okusingira ddala mu bifo obubaka buno we bukozesebwa okukebera endwadde.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí fi hàn pé, ó ṣe pàtàkì fún àwọn aṣèwádìí láti lo àlàyé nípa ẹ̀jẹ̀-ìbí tí ó bágbà mu láti rí i dájú pé wọ́n tọpa àwọn ààrun dé ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn ẹ̀jẹ̀-ìbí tí wọn ń fà wọ́n, ní pàtàkì, àwọn ibi tí àlàyé yìí ti jẹ́ lílò nínú àyẹ̀wò ètò-ilera.
Zulu: Ucwaningolukhombisa ukuthi kubalulekile ukuthi abacwaningi basebenzise ulwazi lofuzo olusha ukuze beqinisekise ukuthi izifo zihlangene nofuzo oluzidalayo, ikakhulukazi uma lolu lwazi lusetshenziswa ukuthola izifo.
Hausa: Binciken ya nuna cewa yana da matukar muhimmanci ga masu bincike su yi amfani da bayanan qwayoyin halitta na zamani don tabbatar da cewa cututtuka suna da alaqa da qwayoyin halittar da ke haifar da su, musamman inda ake amfani da wannan bayanin wajen tantancewar likita.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di laetša gore go bohlokwa gore banyakišiši ba šomiše tshedimošo ya tlhamegotšini ya bjalebjale go kgonthiša gore malwetši a amantšhwa le ditšini tšeo di a hlolago, kudukudu moo tshedimošo ye e šomišwago go phekolo ya malwetši.
Amharic: ጥናቱ እንደሚያሳየው በሽታዎች ከሚያስከስቷቸው ጂኖች ጋር በትክክሉ የተቆራኙ እንደሆኑ ለማረጋገጥ ተመራማሪዎች በተለይም መረጃው ለህክምና ምርመራዎች በሚውልበት ጊዜ  ወቅታዊ የጄኔቲክ መረጃን መጠቀም ያስፈልጋቸዋል፤

English: New tools for updating information between the two assemblies may also make it easier for scientists to transfer information between them in the future.
